name: Level Fulton Market
tagline: Stay steps from Fulton Market’s dining scene, cocktail bars, and creative energy.
description:
Level Fulton Market
At the doorstep of Fulton Market’s acclaimed dining and nightlife, Level Fulton Market offers modern studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom suites for nightly and extended stays. Settle into a city sanctuary with fully equipped kitchens, lounge-worthy living space, in-suite laundry, and private balconies in select suites—each with room to live like a local.

Printed address (General Inquiries / Map): 354 N Union Avenue Chicago, IL, 60661, United States
Front Desk Phone: 312.910.9390
Reservations Phone: 312.724.8778

City destination — Fulton Market card
Stay steps from Fulton Market’s dining scene, cocktail bars, and creative energy. Level Chicago-Fulton Market pairs spacious modern suites with unparalleled lifestyle amenities and dedicated guest services, welcoming both hotel stays and extended visits.

Property Features
Nightly & Extended Stays
Welcoming nightly and extended stays of 30+ nights.
24hr Guest Services
Trusted, caring service available 24 hours a day to assist with local information, restaurant reservations, transportation arrangements or anything else you might need to help you settle in.
Outdoor Pool & Hot Tub
Outdoor heated pool and hot tub with loungers. Open seasonally – Spring & Summer.
Sports & Fitness
Work up a sweat in our state-of-the-art indoor-outdoor fitness center with premium cardio, strength, and weight equipment. Our separate fitness studio space is perfect for yoga, stretching, private classes, or personal training.
Entertainment Spaces
Fully equipped BBQ grilling stations perfect for open air dining with tables and lounge areas with fire pits. Indoors find private dining and lounge areas, games rooms complete with a pool tables, sports lounge,and more.
Pet Friendly
All Level properties are pet friendly. Level Fulton Market offers an onsite secure outdoor dog run and indoor pet spa. Pet fees apply.

Suites
Level Fulton Market features spacious studios, one, two and three-bedroom accommodations in Chicago ranging from 500 to 1,200 sq ft of exceptional living. From monthly studio rentals for one, to multi-room accommodations for the whole family, or team, enjoy the suite way to stay with all the comforts of home: fully-equipped kitchens, functional living areas, personal outdoor balconies and convenient in-suite laundry. Level Chicago in Fulton Market even boasts a 2,554 sqft penthouse too.

Suites page
Choose from a collection of modern studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom accommodations, and a three-bedroom penthouse at Level Fulton Market in Chicago. Enjoy the suite way to stay with all the comforts of home; fully-equipped kitchens, functional living areas, personal outdoor balconies and convenient in-suite laundry. The Penthouse at Fulton Market offers 2,554 sq ft of indoor and outdoor living space with panoramic views of Chicago.

Level Suite — 1 Bed | 1 Bath | Sofa Bed | Sleeps 4 | 488-551 SqFt
A smart, stylish home base in the West Loop. Your studio suite gives you room to unpack, make coffee in a fully equipped kitchen, and reset between city plans. It’s the easy choice for a quick getaway, a work trip, or a longer stay that still feels light and effortless.
Your Level suite is an open-concept studio suite with the freedom to live your day your way. Make breakfast in your fully equipped kitchen with premium appliances, take a call from a dedicated workspace (in select suites), then step onto your private balcony to watch the neighborhood wake up. With in-suite laundry, streaming-ready Smart TV, and modern finishes throughout, it’s an effortless apartment-style hotel stay in Chicago’s West Loop.
Official floorplan (Level Suite PDF): Indoor Area 456 SQ FT; Outdoor Area 67 SQ FT; Total Area 523 SQ FT.

One Bedroom Suite — 1 Bed | 1 Bath | Sofa Bed | Sleeps 4 | 649-684 SqFt
More space to breathe, and a door you can close. Start your morning with a homemade breakfast in the kitchen, then come home after a long day to a separate bedroom that makes winding down feel simple. Perfect for couples or business travelers who want a true one-bedroom suite in the heart of Chicago’s Fulton Market.
The one-bedroom suite gives you the best of both worlds: room to relax together and a bedroom you can close when the day is done. Whip up a meal in your full kitchen, unwind in the living room, then retreat to a separate king bedroom.
Official floorplan (One Bedroom Suite PDF): Indoor Area 610 SQ FT; Outdoor Area 74 SQ FT; Total Area 684 SQ FT.

Junior Two Bedroom Suite — 2 Beds | 2 Baths | Sleeps 4 | 728-781 SqFt
Travel together with space to spare. With the privacy of two bedrooms, this suite makes it easy for families or friends to share the city, then retreat into their own space. Think: kids asleep behind closed doors while the adults catch up in the living area with a glass of wine.
Built for shared stays with space for privacy. With two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and an open living and dining space, this junior two-bedroom suite makes it easy for families, friends, or colleagues to settle in.
Official floorplan (Jr Two Bedroom Suite PDF): Indoor Area 709 SQ FT; Outdoor Area 72 SQ FT; Total Area 781 SQ FT.

Two Bedroom Suite — 2 Beds | 2 Baths | Sofa Bed | Sleeps 6 | 1,035-1,150 SqFt
Designed for longer stays and living locally. Prepare dinner, spread out with room to work, and still have privacy when it’s time to recharge. This two-bedroom suite is ideal for relocations, extended business travel, or a family trip with enough space for everyone to feel at home.
Our Two Bedroom Suites are spacious and sophisticated boasting up to approximately 1,150 sqft of modern living space. Make a home-cooked meal in your fully equipped kitchen, host friends in your open concept living and dining area, and take in the city views on your open-air balcony. All suites also feature in-suite laundry, premium appliances, smart TV with access to your favorite streaming apps, and complimentary Wi-Fi.
Official floorplan (Two Bedroom Suite PDF): Indoor Area 928 SQ FT; Outdoor Area 107 SQ FT; Total Area 1,035 SQ FT.

Two Bedroom Sky Suite — 2 Beds | 2 Baths | Sofa Bed | Sleeps 6 | 1,369 SqFt
A higher floor stay with lofty views. The two-bedroom sky suite gives you extra space to host, relax, and appreciate Chicago’s skyline from your private balcony with a grill. Ideal for special occasions, longer stays, or anyone who wants the city at their feet and calm at home.
Designed for elevated city living, the two-bedroom sky suite pairs generous interiors with skyline views you’ll want to linger over. Start the day with coffee on your private balcony, then come home to a suite that makes longer stays feel effortless: a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable living.
Official floorplan (Two Bedroom Sky Suite PDF): Indoor Area 1,114 SQ FT; Outdoor Area 255 SQ FT; Total Area 1,369 SQ FT.

Three Bedroom Suite — 3 Beds | 2 Baths | Sofa Bed | Sleeps 8 | 1,179 SqFt
Big city energy, big-suite comfort. With three private bedrooms and generous gathering space, this suite is made for group stays where you want both together time and quiet time. Order in from a favorite Chicago eatery, put a movie on, then retreat to your own room.
A rare find in Chicago’s West Loop: a true three-bedroom suite with space for everyone. This roomy suite is ideal for families, group trips, or extended stays where you want together time without sacrificing privacy. Make breakfast in the kitchen, spread out across multiple bedrooms, then kick back in the living area for a movie night before tomorrow’s Chicago sightseeing fun. It’s a suite way to stay when you need comfort, function, and room to breathe.
Official floorplan (Three Bedroom Suite PDF): Indoor Area 1,095 SQ FT; Outdoor Area 84 SQ FT; Total Area 1,179 SQ FT.

Suites amenity strip
Fully-equipped kitchens — Whether you’re looking to unleash your inner chef, or just want the peace of mind that comes with preparing your favorite meal the way you do at home, our kitchens make the perfect sous chef. Enjoy the convenience of our fully outfitted kitchens featuring top-of-the-line appliances.
Lounge-worthy living space — Level suites are thoughtfully designed with layouts that give you space for the things you love – unlike traditional hotels.
In-Suite Laundry — Enjoy the convenience of a full-sized energy efficient washer and dryer in each suite.
Private Outdoor Spaces — At Level Fulton Market, Chicago has never felt more like home. Most suites feature open-air balconies – great for enjoying your morning coffee, soaking up some afternoon sun, or reading that book you’ve been putting off.
Housekeeping Services — Complimentary bi-weekly housekeeping ensures your suite remains a haven of comfort.

Amenities
From a state-of-the-art fitness center and infrared saunas to a modern co-work space and a glamorous 31st-floor “Cloud Lounge” where you can meet and collaborate with colleagues, Level’s resort-inspired amenities are designed with your lifestyle in mind.
Our thoughtful lifestyle amenities at Fulton Market enable you to maintain or elevate your daily fitness routine in our state-of-the-art gym. Relax poolside, let off some steam with a little ping-pong and more.

Amenities page
Resort-inspired spaces, built for city living
Recharge your way with a state-of-the-art fitness center, steam room, and infrared sauna, plus an indoor pool, hot tub, and a large outdoor pool open seasonally for sunny Chicago afternoons. When it’s time to shift gears, co-working spaces make remote work effortless, while the rooftop Cloud Lounge delivers skyline views for gatherings, celebrations, and elevated nights in. Back in your suite, enjoy high-speed Wi-Fi, a smart TV with streaming access, and the ease of 24-hour guest services—perfect for a weekend escape or an extended stay in Chicago. Level Fulton Market is also pet-friendly, with an indoor dog park, seasonal outdoor dog run, and a pet spa.

Stay for a night. Stay for a while.
From weekend getaways to extended visits, Level is a refreshing alternative to traditional hotels—with more space, more comfort, and more flexibility. Choose from modern studios to multi-bedroom suites in destinations you’ll want to explore all day and come home to at night.

Monthly Stays
Level Fulton Market is ideal for guests who want an extended stay in Chicago without putting life on pause—whether you’re relocating, traveling for work, looking for corporate housing, navigating an insurance stay during home repairs, or settling in for a longer city escape. With dedicated workspaces, distinct amenities to recharge, and a location in the heart of Fulton Market’s dining scene, it’s a stay that fits families, couples, and solo travelers alike. Add warm 24-hour Guest Services, housekeeping and a pet-friendly atmosphere, and you’ve got a home base that feels effortless from day one.

Eat, Drink and Explore Chicago
From world-class restaurants and cocktail bars to boutiques and galleries, Fulton Market is one of the city’s most exciting places to explore. Stay close to it all—then come home to space, comfort, and the suite way to escape.

Neighborhood
Whether you are on an extended vacation, a business trip, a weekend away, or in the process of moving, live like a local while you stay at Level Fulton Market. We’ve curated a list of our favorite spots in the neighborhood to help you get started.

Map, Parking & Transportation
Address: 354 N Union Avenue Chicago, IL, 60661, United States
Parking: Secure self-parking is available onsite. $68 per night. First come, first basis, per night – per vehicle. Parking cannot be reserved in advance. Max 2 cars.
Penthouse parking note: Secure self-parking is available onsite. Monthly fees apply.
Public Transportation: From O’Hare International Airport take the Blue Line 15 stops from “O’Hare” to “Grand”. Walk approximately 8 minutes – Head west on W Grand Ave toward N Green St; Turn left onto N Green St; Turn left onto W Kinzie St; Turn right onto N Union Ave and arrive at Level Fulton Market. Uber and Lyft ride sharing also operate throughout the city.
Getting Here from O’Hare International Airport (ORD): Level Fulton Market is 17.1 miles from ORD. Take I-90 E; Use the left lane to take the exit toward Armitage Ave; Merge onto I-90/I-94; Turn right onto N Orleans St.; Turn right onto W Grand Ave; Turn left onto N Desplaines St; Turn right onto W Kinzie St; Turn left at the 1st cross street onto N Union Ave.

Frequently Asked Questions
What are the Level Chicago - Fulton Market check-in and check-out times?
Early check-in or late check-out requests are based upon availability and may incur additional charges. Please inquire directly with the property you are staying at for check-in/out requests.
Level Chicago – Fulton Market
Check-in: 4 pm | Check-out: 11am
Arrival Information
Level Chicago – Fulton Market has an entrance on N Union Avenue
Use the front entrance to gain access to the building
Check in with Guest Services
You will be required to sign the Terms and Conditions and provide a valid ID and credit card for incidentals. Parking stall instructions provided at check-in.
Minimum Check-in Age: 21
Individuals under the age of 21 are not allowed to check in or occupy a room unless they are accompanied by an adult, whether it be a parent or guardian.

What can I expect in my suite?
Fully-equipped kitchen with appliances, pots, pans, dishes, utensils and cutlery
In-suite washer/dryer and ironing set
Smart TVs
Wireless internet, local calling and voicemail
Heating and air conditioning
Premium furnishings and linens
Access to our lifestyle amenities and dedicated concierge services
Bi-weekly housekeeping for monthly stays and every six nights for hotel stays.

What makes Level Hotels & Furnished Suites different than a standard hotel?
The biggest difference is space. Our suites range anywhere from 475 square feet to over 2,000 and boast fully-equipped kitchens, in-suite washer and dryer and all the essentials to enjoy a space of your own while away from home.

What is my reservation cancellation policy?
For hotel stays, please refer to the cancellation policy outlined in your confirmation e-mail.
For extended stays, guests may be liable to pay cancelation charges of up to 100% of the negotiated rent for the balance of the term of the Accommodation Agreement. Please note that a change in the length or dates of your reservation may result in a rate change.

The Penthouse
An Urban Sanctuary in Chicago
Rising above Fulton Market, the three-bedroom penthouse suite at Level delivers 2,554 square feet of expansive indoor-outdoor space with Chicago skyline views in every direction. From sunset drinks on the terrace to late-night soaks in the private rooftop hot tub, this is a luxury stay in Chicago’s West Loop designed for hosting, celebrating, and living beautifully in the city.

The Penthouse at Fulton Market
This three-bedroom three-bathroom penthouse boasts 2,554 sq ft of luxury indoor and outdoor living, with stunning views of the Chicago skyline in every corner. It features inviting interiors with top-notch finishes and a European-inspired kitchen. The penthouse offers unrivaled entertainment options, including a private rooftop hot tub, terrace, fireplace and dining area.
Warm, Rich and Spacious Interiors — Spanning 1,754 sq ft, the Fulton Market penthouse interior features warm, natural wood grains, stone and marble. Think plush furnishings, luxurious, smooth finishes and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Your dream kitchen — Create, dine and entertain in this dream, European-inspired kitchen featuring a Milano fridge, convection oven and 5 burner gas cooktops. Warm marble, lights and intimate seating meld luxury with comfort.
Elevated Outdoor Living — Lounge on the main floor terrace with a glass of wine, or take a trip upstairs to spread out on the private rooftop terrace – a 800 sq ft space with lounge chairs, a hot tub and unparalleled views of Chicago’s cityscape.
Space for Entertaining — Sit by the fireplace for hors d’oeuvres, cozy up at the kitchen bar top to watch the action, or enjoy good conversations at the eight-seated dining area.
Official floorplan (The Penthouse at Fulton Market PDF): Indoor 1,754 SQ FT; Outdoor 800 SQ FT; Total 2,554 SQ FT.

name: Level River North
tagline: Luxury furnished short-term rentals in Chicago’s River North neighborhood.
description:
Level River North
In a city known for its neighborhoods, River North stands out. You’ll find chic galleries, buzz-worthy restaurants and vibrant nightlife in this hub for arts and entertainment. The best shopping in Chicago is minutes away at The Magnificent Mile, the Loop business district is just across the river, and plenty of fresh air and green space can be found riverside. Nestled in the heart of it all, an artful blend between luxury apartments and boutique hotel, Level River North is stylishly sophisticated. Just like Chicago.
Available for nightly and extended stays, Level River North offers spacious studio, one and two-bedroom accommodations boasting fully-equipped kitchens, modern design, 24 hour Guest Services and access to unparalleled lifestyle amenities. Apartments for rent furnished and appointed with the conveniences of home and amenities of luxury travel make the suite life at Level River North anything but routine.

Printed address (General Inquires / Map): 369 W Grand Avenue, Chicago, IL 60654
Front Desk Phone: 312.858.5482
Reservations Phone: 312.724.8778

City destination — River North card
Luxury furnished short-term rentals in Chicago’s River North neighborhood. From galleries and nightlife to quick access to the Chicago Riverwalk and Navy Pier, River North keeps you connected to the city’s pulse. Level Chicago - River North features spacious suites, unparalleled lifestyle amenities, and dedicated guest services, welcoming those seeking a hotel stay or a monthly stay.

Property Features
Nightly & Extended Stays
Welcoming extended stays of 30+ nights.
24hr Guest Services
Trusted, caring service available 24 hours a day to assist with local information, restaurant reservations, travel arrangements or anything else you might need to help you settle in.
Outdoor Pool & Hot Tub
Outdoor heated pool and hot tub with luxurious loungers and daybeds. Open seasonally – Spring & Summer.
Fully-equipped Gym
Fully-equipped fitness facility featuring premium cardio, strength and weight equipment, towel service and dry sauna.
Entertainment Spaces
From terrace BBQs to an expansive indoor lounge to exquisite dining spaces with adjacent catering kitchens, enjoy entertaining spaces worth celebrating.
Pet Friendly
Amenities include indoor pet parlour and outdoor dog run.

Suites
Upgrade your downtown Chicago experience with a space to call home. With Level’s suite and accessible living at River North apartments for rental monthly feature fully-equipped kitchens, spacious living areas, and convenient in-suite laundry. Many suites also feature separate bedrooms and private outdoor balconies. Modern in style, personal in space.

Suites page
Apartment-style hotel suites in the heart of Chicago’s River North
Surrounded by galleries, destination dining, nightlife, and steps from the Chicago Riverwalk and Navy Pier, Level Chicago River North places you in the center of one of the city’s most energetic neighborhoods. Choose from studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites, or settle into a statement penthouse high above it all designed for both hotel stays and extended stays.
Inside, each suite is designed to feel calm and livable, offering fully-equipped kitchens, in-suite laundry, and separate living and sleeping areas that let you shift easily between work and downtime. After exploring River North’s art scene, shopping, and dining, return home to space that feels personal, polished, and unmistakably Chicago.

Level Studio Suite — 1 Bed | 1 Bath | Sofa Bed | Sleeps 4 | 542 SqFt
Smart, streamlined, and designed for flexibility, the Level Suite offers an open-concept layout with space to cook, lounge, and rest comfortably. Ideal for solo travelers or couples who want the ease of a hotel apartment with the feeling of home.
The Level Suite at Level Chicago River North is designed for guests who want the ease of city living with space to settle in. Start your morning with coffee in your well-stocked kitchen, step out into River North’s galleries and dining scene, then return to a space that feels calm and considered. The open layout blends sleeping and living areas for effortless hotel stays or longer solo visits, supported by in-suite laundry, high-speed Wi-Fi, and smart storage that keeps life uncluttered.

The One Bedroom Suite brings balance and privacy to the heart of River North in Chicago. A separate bedroom makes it easy to disconnect at the end of the day, while the living area and well-equipped kitchen support everything from remote work to relaxed evenings in. With custom mattresses, premium linens, and in-suite laundry, this suite is ideal for corporate travel, couples, or guests settling in for an extended city stay.

Amenities

Amenities page
Sophisticated and modern, all the comforts of home
At Level Chicago River North, amenities are designed to extend life beyond your suite. More than 30,000 square feet of lifestyle amenities give you room to stay active, stay focused, or simply switch off. Start your morning in the fitness center, cool down with a swim in the rooftop pool and hot tub, or unwind in one of the entertainment lounges after a day in the city. Whether you’re working remotely or winding down, these spaces support everyday routines—just a little sweeter. River North is pet-friendly, with an indoor dog park and outdoor dog run perfect for Chicago winters, plus an on-site pet spa, making longer stays easy for every member of the household.

Flexible stays, built for real life
From hotel stays to extended visits, Level River North offers flexibility without compromise. Apartment-style layouts, thoughtfully designed amenities, and warm, attentive guest services make it easy to stay longer—and feel settled upon arrival.

Extended stays, well placed
Ideal for extended stays in Chicago, Level River North is a natural fit for corporate travel, relocations, insurance stays—the perfect home away from home. With easy access to the Loop, the Chicago Riverwalk, and the Magnificent Mile, enjoy the balance of work, comfort, and city living.

Explore River North
Known for its gallery-lined streets, destination dining, and vibrant nightlife, River North places you a short walk from the Chicago Riverwalk, Navy Pier, and some of the city’s most buzzed-about neighborhoods. The Penthouse at Level River North -Chicago-
Set above one of the city’s most dynamic neighborhoods, The Penthouse at Level Chicago River North offers a rare penthouse experience in Chicago, defined by scale, privacy, and location. Spanning more than 6,400 square feet of luxury indoor and outdoor living, this three-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom penthouse is designed for guests who want room to live, host, and unwind—high above the energy of River North.

Outdoor Living Above the City — With more than 2,100 square feet of private outdoor space, the terrace becomes an extension of the living space. Lounge, dine, and unwind outside, or soak in the private hot tub while taking in sweeping skyline views—an ideal setting for entertaining or quiet moments above the city.
The Comfort of Home, Elevated by Service — Alongside the privacy of a fully appointed luxury residence, guests enjoy hotel-style guest services, housekeeping, secure parking, and access to River North lifestyle amenities. It’s a seamless blend of independence and hospitality.

Walton Residence
A Hidden Gem in Gold Coast
Nestled in the prestigious Gold Coast neighborhood of Chicago, the Walton Residence has seamlessly combined the personalized service & amenities of a five-star hotel, with the space & comfort of high-end apartment living.
In an iconic building right off the Magnificent Mile, the Walton Residence provides access to the best shopping and restaurants in the city, while providing its residents with privacy and comfort.
Offering one, two and three bedroom fully furnished luxury rentals and flexible lease options for any length of stay, the Walton Residence is the perfect option for either a short weekend getaway, or an extended stay in the heart of Chicago.

Stay — Gold Coast Living
Contemporary living & timeless comfort meet luxury amenities & hotel style service in our Chicago apartment homes. Featuring one-, two- and three-bedroom, fully furnished units, with fully equipped kitchens, charming fireplaces, weekly housekeeping and complimentary wash and fold laundry.

With soaring ceilings, tons of natural light, and a privileged corner location with unobstructed views, our two-bedroom duplex units are ideal for families or the solo traveler seeking extra space without compromising on luxury. Including gourmet kitchens, working fireplaces, Brazilian hardwood floors, luxury terry & linens, Juice Beauty Organic bath amenities, and in unit washers/dryers.

With generous two-floor layouts, six-person dining rooms and spacious kitchens, our three-bedroom duplex units are perfect for larger families or if you are traveling with a group of friends. Including gourmet kitchens, working fireplaces, Brazilian hardwood floors, luxury terry & linens, Juice Beauty Organic bath amenities, and in unit washers/dryers.

THE WALTON RESIDENCE
Live Like a Local
So much more than an extended-stay hotel, the Walton Residence offers unparalleled, personalized service and incredible amenities in an iconic 1920s-era building in the heart of Chicago’s Gold Coast neighborhood. With instant access to the city’s best dining, shopping, and entertainment, 70 East Walton residents live without compromise, and on their own terms.

YOUR GOLD COAST HOME
Inquire About The Walton Residence
70 East Walton offers custom leasing options, a staggering list of amenities, and the ultimate in privacy and comfort. If you are interested in a short or longer-term stay at one of our residences, please provide us with the requested information and our team will contact you shortly.
Contact Us — 312-787-8080

Rates
Walton Residence offers a collection of thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments to elevate modern furnished living.
Rates are seasonally adjusted based on lease timing—reflecting low-, high-, and annual terms—and may vary by floor plan and floor level.
Each residence includes utilities, high-speed internet, cable, housekeeping, and laundry services, creating a convenient, all-inclusive living experience. No security deposit or additional leasing fees are required.
For pet owners, a one-time pet fee of $300 and a monthly pet rent of $35 apply. An application fee of $100 is required.
Request a Quote for your Stay — Call Leasing at 312.787.8080

Getting Here / Location (home card)
Live like a local in the middle of the action without compromising on space, luxury, and privacy at the Walton Residence. Just steps from the dynamic retail of Oak & Rush streets, a five minute walk to Oak Street Beach, and with some of the city’s best restaurants right at your doorstep, you will fall in love with Gold Coast and see why Chicago has been named “Best Big City in the United States” by Conde Nast Magazine.

Location — Life in Chicago’s Gold Coast
There’s no better way to experience the historic Gold Coast neighborhood than staying at the Walton Residence. Close to everywhere you want to go and steps away from dynamic retail, entertainment, and some of the top restaurants in Chicago, you’ll fall right into the Gold Coast lifestyle. Voted “Best Big City in the United States” by Condé Nast Readers’ Choice Awards, Chicago has something for everyone
The Neighborhood
Gold Coast is an iconic area nestled along the shores of Lake Michigan, just north of downtown. Renowned for its opulent charm and historic architecture, the Gold Coast is a captivating blend of stately mansions, upscale shopping, and tree-lined streets that exude a timeless elegance.
Along Oak Street and the famous Magnificent Mile, residents and visitors alike indulge in luxury shopping, high-end boutiques, and gourmet dining. The Gold Coast’s proximity to the lakefront allows for leisurely strolls along the picturesque beaches and access to the Lakefront Trail. The neighborhood strikes a perfect balance between the tranquility of its residential areas and the vibrancy of its commercial districts, making it a coveted destination for those seeking a sophisticated urban lifestyle in the heart of Chicago.
While there are endless options for restaurants, shopping, and things to do in and around the Gold Coast, we have curated a selection of some of our favorite restaurants and activities for your convenience.
